name: MI floor ratio from opening bid alone

arv.basis: Assumed floor, not a valuation of this parcel. No assessed value, provider estimate or comps were available, so this is the opening bid of $4,500 times 2.24 — the conservative quartile of the value-to-opening-bid ratio across 2,189 MI parcels where both figures are known (measured 2026-08-11). The middle half of those parcels ran 2.24x to 11.51x, so the true figure could plausibly be $51,795. Treat this as a starting magnitude for research, never as a reason to bid — enter real comps before you do.
